title: Translate Error in Chinese
author: Mr-Python-in-China
summary: A Chinese PowerToys Run time-unit string translated `second` as the ordinal `第二个` instead of the duration unit `秒`; the issue was sent to the localization team.
next_action: Verify the current Simplified Chinese resource in PowerToys Run and close only if the shipped UI now uses `秒`.

confidence.rationale: The translation error and ownership are explicit; only current shipment status is unknown.

judgment.rationale: The linguistic error is specific and accepted by maintainers, but the public thread never confirms which shipped resource version contains the correction.
evidence: The screenshot and reporter identify the exact incorrect and expected Chinese terms.
The reporter clarified in 2023 that the issue was not solved.
A maintainer linked an internal localization work item and the policy service said the issue was raised to the localization team.
judgment.recommended_action: Verify the current Simplified Chinese resource in PowerToys Run and close only if the shipped UI now uses `秒`.

fix_assessment.rationale: The defect is owned by the localization pipeline, and public evidence does not identify a PowerToys source-code change.

issue_context.summary: A Chinese PowerToys Run time-unit string translated `second` as the ordinal `第二个` instead of the duration unit `秒`; the issue was sent to the localization team.
known_information: The original affected version is PowerToys 0.58.0.
The issue is labeled `Loc-Sent To Team` and `Issue-Translation`.
The linked work item is internal and does not provide public completion evidence.
inferences: A localization pipeline update may already have corrected the resource, but the GitHub record does not prove shipment.
issue_context.analysis: A current-language UI check is sufficient; no PowerToys code design should be started for work owned by the localization pipeline.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue and all seven comments, including the correction to the reporter's ambiguous `No` response.
Confirmed the only ownership evidence is the localization-team handoff.

actions.label: Verify Chinese time-unit translation
actions.note: Maintainer-side verification only; this artifact performs no upstream write.

reproduce.title: Check the affected PowerToys Run duration string
prerequisites: Windows or PowerToys language set to Simplified Chinese
setup: Open PowerToys Run in the language configuration shown by the original report.
Navigate to or trigger the result that displays the affected `second` duration string.
steps: Read the localized unit in the same UI position shown in the issue.
Confirm the text uses `秒` for duration rather than `第二个` for an ordinal.
Record the current PowerToys version and language.
reproduce.expected_result: The duration unit is displayed as `秒`; if confirmed, the issue can be closed as fixed by localization.
